notes.title: The fog won't let you go
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39197129/1551bef5611c1343289b1b07f8d59eeb543e2e94.png[/img]

List of changes:
[list]
[*] Reworked the visual part of the open space
[*] Fixed a bug due to which sometimes it was not possible to connect to the created game
[*] Reducing internet traffic by 30-40% when playing online, which should have a good effect on synchronization
[*] Fixed a bug that led to the disappearance or teleportation of animals when attacking the player
[*] Fixing a bug where when you click on the recorder button, the game is not saved
[*] Fixed a bug where the password input keyboard in the basement did not respond to pressing
[*] Fixed incorrect lighting near the garage after a tractor drove into it
[*] Fixed a bug when after death the player's body began to fly and behave incorrectly
[*] Improved visibility when the player is sitting and attacking chickens
[*] Added additional hints in the game showing objects for interaction
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39197129/a84551e8bce094fb0ddb38ebf5a5cfbd63b2bb1e.png[/img]
